summary: Smoke regression (frontend-only, no backend) on Expo web preview at 390x844 mobile viewport, after the .gitignore-only change (removed .env ignore patterns) — verifies zero runtime regressions before the user retries the Android EAS Build (previous 503 was an external Expo outage, not our code). All 6 requested scenarios PASS: (1) App boots to nuovo-screen with 'Nuovo episodio' title, no red screen, no pageerror events, no console errors. (2) Save flow: intensity-pill-3 + factor-chip-sport + nota 'smoke test nota' → save-button → toast 'Episodio salvato' fires, nota-input clears to empty (form reset), episodi_v1 localStorage contains 1 active episode with scala_mal_di_testa=3, sport=true, all other flags=false, correct ISO timestamp; app remains on nuovo-screen (no unwanted navigation). (3) Storico: 1 saved card visible via episode-card-{id}; delete-button-{id} → confirm-delete-{id} soft-deletes; toast 'Episodio eliminato'; empty list afterwards. (4) Andamento: open-grafico-button routes to grafico-screen; intensity-chart renders with data point at scala 2; stat-count shows '1 Episodi', media '2,0', massimo '2'; 'Fattori ricorrenti' section renders. (5) CSV export: export-csv-button triggers a real browser download; captured file header is exactly 'id,timestamp,scala_mal_di_testa,treno_bus,tanto_schermo,sport,scuola,algifor,itinerol,bevuto_poco,riposato_poco,nota' — all 12 columns in the correct order — and the one data row is present. (6) CSV import: import-csv-button opens import-confirm-modal; import-confirm-button opens the file chooser; injected 1-row valid CSV (scala 4, treno_bus=1, scuola=1, riposato_poco=1, nota="nota importata") → toast reads exactly 'Importati 1 episodio' (singular form correct), FlatList refreshes to 1 card, imported nota 'nota importata' is visible on the card. Feature ships clean, safe to retry EAS Build deploy.
critical_code_review_comments: No runtime code changed since iteration 4 — only /app/.gitignore was edited to remove .env ignore patterns (a deploy-health-check finding). Regression scope is a smoke check only, and all six user-facing flows behave identically to the last full-pass iteration.

index.tsx onSave (line 83–98): correctly awaits addEpisode before showing toast + resetForm; setSaving guard prevents double-taps; error branch surfaces an Italian error toast. Confirmed by observed happy path.

storico.tsx doImport (line 78–96): pickCsvText null (user cancel) short-circuits before setImporting(true), replaceAllEpisodes only runs on a successful parseCsv. Error path preserves data (previously exhaustively verified in iteration 4).
csv.ts buildCsv HEADER (line 8–21): 12 columns confirmed via live download in this iteration.

db.ts webSave / webLoad: JSON.stringify is applied both at db.ts layer (line 123) and again inside storage.setItem, producing double-encoded episodi_v1 in localStorage — cosmetic hygiene note carried over from iterations 3–4; round-trips cleanly, no functional impact.
seed_data_creation: During run: cleared localStorage['episodi_v1'] at start. Saved 1 episode (scala 3 + sport + 'smoke test nota') → deleted it via Storico → saved another (scala 2 + algifor + 'for chart') to feed the chart. After CSV export test, imported a fresh 1-row CSV replacing all data; final active state = 1 imported episode (scala 4, treno_bus+scuola+riposato_poco, 'nota importata').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web URL: https://episode-logger-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Environment date is Aug 2026 — new episodes get 2026-08 timestamps and fall inside Andamento's default '30 giorni' filter (chart populates as expected). CSV export triggers a real browser download on web (page.expect_download works). CSV import uses page.expect_file_chooser() + fc.set_files({buffer}). localStorage 'episodi_v1' is DOUBLE-encoded (parse twice). Deprecated packages: none detected. SafeAreaView: uses useSafeAreaInsets — correct. No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch anywhere.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Prior deploy failure was Expo EAS Build API 503 (external outage) after a successful bundle upload, unrelated to app code. Smoke regression confirms the app is fully functional and safe to redeploy.
